content.original: There are two main settlements in this area. You know how this goes. Let's do a sweep and get more info, Commander. And let's hope this is just a case of some bad comms systems... the alternative won't be pretty.
content.prevOriginal: There are two main settlements in this area. You know how this goes. Let's do a sweep and get more info, Commander. And let's hope this is just a case of some bad comms systems... the alternative won't be pretty.
content.content: В этом районе два основных поселения. Давайте проведем разведку и получим больше информации, командир. Будем надеяться, что это просто сбой связи... в противном случае... ничего хорошего.

content.original: Thank you, Commander. I'll personally make sure this witness makes a difference at the trial.
content.prevOriginal: Thank you, Commander. I'll personally make sure this witness makes a difference at the trial.
content.content: Спасибо, командир. Я лично прослежу, чтобы этот свидетель произвел впечатление на суде.

content.original: Nice to make a difference. Especially when we get paid.
content.prevOriginal: Nice to make a difference. Especially when we get paid.
content.content: Производить впечатление - это хорошо. Особенно когда нам за это платят.

content.original: This isn't looking good. We're coming to get you out fast. We can't do anything else to help this poor soul.
content.prevOriginal: This isn't looking good. We're coming to get you out fast. We can't do anything else to help this poor soul.
content.content: Выглядит не очень хорошо. Мы идём, чтобы поскорее забрать вас. Этим бедолагам мы уже ничем не поможем.

content.original: There's nothing here. This settlement looks long abandoned. Let's quickly move on to the next one.
content.prevOriginal: There's nothing here. This settlement looks long abandoned. Let's quickly move on to the next one.
content.content: Здесь ничего нет. Всё поселение выглядит давно заброшенным. Давайте двигаться к следующему.

content.original: Gotcha! I'm not going down without a fight, you bastards. I saw what you did and I'll let the whole world know at the trial!
content.prevOriginal: Gotcha! I'm not going down without a fight, you bastards. I saw what you did and I'll let the whole world know at the trial!
content.content: Попались! Я не сдамся без боя, ушлёпки! Я видел, что вы сделали, и расскажу об этом всему миру на суде!

content.original: I recognise that voice... that's the witness! This seems to be a recorded message though...
content.prevOriginal: I recognise that voice... that's the witness! This seems to be a recorded message though...
content.content: Узнаю этот голос... это наш свидетель! Хотя, похоже, это всего лишь запись...

content.original: That's real great - they think we're after them. Turrets spinning up! Better deal with this first then we can go 'thank' the witness.
content.prevOriginal: That's real great - they think we're after them. Turrets spinning up! Better deal with this first then we can go 'thank' the witness.
content.content: Ну, здорово, нас приняли за бандитов. Турели раскручиваются! Лучше сперва разобраться с ними, а свидетеля мы позже «поблагодарим».

content.original: Right where we were told you'd... wait... you're not who we're looking for! We'll just have to go through you lot first then.
content.prevOriginal: Right where we were told you'd... wait... you're not who we're looking for! We'll just have to go through you lot first then.
content.content: Как раз там, где нам и сказали... эй, погоди-ка... вы не те, кого мы ищем! Выходит, придётся сперва пройти сквозь вас.

content.original: Multiple contacts. Incoming hostiles. Engage at will, Commander.
content.prevOriginal: Multiple contacts. Incoming hostiles. Engage at will, Commander.
content.content: Множественные контакты. Приближается противник. Вступайте в бой по готовности, командир.

content.original: What a pain that was. We couldn't even trace the location of the witness as it was just a recording. We've got no choice but to head to the next settlement and hope they're there.
content.prevOriginal: What a pain that was. We couldn't even trace the location of the witness as it was just a recording. We've got no choice but to head to the next settlement and hope they're there.
content.content: Возни-то сколько! Мы ещё даже не отследили местоположение свидетеля, у нас на руках лишь эта запись. Выбора нет, надо идти в следующий населённый пункт и надеяться, что он там.

content.original: No doubt that party was thrown for our witness. We better hurry to the other settlement. They might need more help.
content.prevOriginal: No doubt that party was thrown for our witness. We better hurry to the other settlement. They might need more help.
content.content: Без сомнения, эта компашка припёрлась по душу нашего свидетеля. Лучше нам поспешить в следующее поселение. Там тоже наверняка понадобится наша помощь.

content.original: You're too late. We've secured this site and once we find that damn snitch we're taking them with us to suffer and there's not a goddamn thing you can do to stop us.
content.prevOriginal: You're too late. We've secured this site and once we find that damn snitch we're taking them with us to suffer and there's not a goddamn thing you can do to stop us.
content.content: Вы опоздали. Это место теперь наше, и как только мы найдём этого грёбаного стукача, то заберём и его, и вашей пачке здесь делать нечего.

content.original: Sounds like they haven't found our witness yet. Good.
content.prevOriginal: Sounds like they haven't found our witness yet. Good.
content.content: Похоже, они ещё не нашли нашего свидетеля. Хорошо.

content.original: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force, you're outgunned and outmatched. Release your captive and surrender or we'll be forced to fire on your position.
content.prevOriginal: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force, you're out gunned and out matched. Release your captive and surrender or we'll be forced to fire on your position.
content.content: Силы {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, вас превосходят числом и огневой мощью. Отдайте пленника и сдавайтесь, иначе мы будем вынуждены открыть огонь по вашей позиции.

content.original: ...Ha! That's what you think. Time to go, boys!
content.prevOriginal: ...Ha! That's what you think. Time to go, boys!
content.content: ...Ха! Это ты так думаешь. Пора двигаться, ребята!

content.original: They've activated the base turrets, Commander. Add that to the pile of things to handle.
content.prevOriginal: They've activated the base turrets, Commander. Add that to the pile of things to handle.
content.content: Они активировали турели базы, командир. Добавлю это к куче проблем, которые нужно решать.

content.original: Hey Commander! I'm the one they're looking for. These bastards murdered a whole town including my family. Let's hurt them. I've just finished setting up a trap so let me help you help me.
content.prevOriginal: Hey Commander! I'm the one they're looking for. These bastards murdered a whole town including my family. Let's hurt them. I've just finished setting up a trap so let me help you help me.
content.content: Алло, командир! Я - тот, кого они ищут. Эти ублюдки убили всех в посёлке, и мою семью. Теперь пускай пострадают они. Я только что закончил ставить ловушку. Я помогу вам помочь мне.

content.original: Commander! Turrets are coming online... they aren't pointed at us though. Looks like we've got some backup.
content.prevOriginal: Commander! Turrets are coming online... they aren't pointed at us though. Looks like we've got some backup.
content.content: Командир! Турели оживают... хотя они вроде не на нас направлены. Похоже, они помогают нам.

content.original: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} settlement. We're a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} aligned force attempting to offer aid and support. What's the current situation here?
content.prevOriginal: {TGT_SYSTEM.name} settlement. We're a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} aligned force attempting to offer aid and support. What's the current situation here?
content.content: Внимание, поселение {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Мы — союзные силы {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}, прибыли оказать помощь и поддержку. Какова текущая ситуация здесь?

content.original: Am I glad to see you guys. I'm in witness protection but these murdering bastards found me. I watched them burn my wife and son and do the same for my whole damn town. Now they want to do the same here. Please... stop them!
content.prevOriginal: Am I glad to see you guys. I'm in witness protection but these murdering bastards found me. I watched them burn my wife and son and do the same for my whole damn town. Now they want to do the same here. Please... stop them!
content.content: Как я рад видеть вас, ребята. Я нахожусь под программой защиты свидетелей, но эти ублюдки-убийцы нашли меня. Я видел, как они сожгли мою жену и сына и сделали то же самое со всем моим проклятым городом. Теперь они хотят сделать то же самое здесь. Пожалуйста... остановите их!

content.original: Hold tight. We'll do what we can.
content.prevOriginal: Hold tight. We'll do what we can.
content.content: Держитесь крепче. Мы сделаем всё, что в наших силах.

content.original: Commander, you've got an incoming Leopard on your position. They'll be on you in moments.
content.prevOriginal: Commander, you've got an incoming Leopard on your position. They'll be on you in moments.
content.content: Командир, к вашей позиции приближается «Леопард». Они будут рядом с вами с минуты на минуту.

content.original: A Minor Royal Pain
content.prevOriginal: A Minor Royal Pain
content.content: Небольшая высокородная боль

content.original:
Commander, we need you in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system immediately. We lost contact with one of the minor royals of the region - Henriette Bosh. They frequently bombard us with a constant stream of requests yet, since some time, we haven't heard from them.

Please check on them and report back to us.
content.prevOriginal:
Commander, we need you in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system immediately. We lost contact with one of the minor royals of the region - Henriette Bosh. They frequently bombard us with a constant stream of requests yet, since some time, we haven't heard from them.

Командир, вы срочно нужны нам в системе {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Мы потеряли связь с одной из влиятельных королевских особ этого региона - Генриеттой Бош. Она часто закидывала нас постоянным потоком просьб, но с некоторых пор мы ничего не слышим о ней.

Пожалуйста, проведайте её и доложите нам.

content.original: Typical hire-a-merc baby sitting job. A royal going silent is unusual though. Usually we'd hope for them to shut up. Let's hope it's just some faulty communications but expect trouble.
content.prevOriginal: Typical hire-a-merc baby sitting job. A royal going silent is unusual though. Usually we'd hope for them to shut up. Let's hope it's just some faulty communications but expect trouble.

content.prevOriginal: {MC.If.Encounter.HasTag.mc_solved_crime}Darius, inform {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} that we're bringing Henriette in on charges of murder and other illegal activities.

content.original:
Commander, we need you to confirm the status of a supply cache in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system that we established in case we need to execute local operations. Your company will run a patrol through the region, passing by the dumps and establishing communications by tightbeam only.

Do not attempt to contact the cache by radio and maintain a low profile, discretion is paramount on this operation.
content.prevOriginal:
Commander, we need you to confirm the status of a supply cache in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system that we established in case we need to execute local operations. Your company will run a patrol through the region, passing by the dumps and establishing communications by tightbeam only.

Do not attempt to contact the cache by radio and maintain a low profile, discretion is paramount on this operation.
content.content:
Командир, нам нужно, чтобы вы проверили состояние тайника со снабжением в системе {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, который мы создали на случай проведения местных операций. Ваша группа будет патрулировать регион, проходя вдоль свалок. Поддерживайте связь только по узконаправленному лучу.

Не пытайтесь связаться с тайником по радио и не высвечивайте, осторожность в этой операции имеет первостепенное значение.

content.original: Oh sure, dropping in a merc 'Mech company to check your secret supply cache is the very definition of discretion. Commander, if this doesn't go sideways I may die of shock.

content.content: Ага, конечно, забрасывать роту наёмных мехов, чтобы проверить секретный тайник с припасами, - это само определение секретности. Командир, если дело НЕ пойдёт наперекосяк, я буду крайне удивлён.

content.original: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence reports a massive {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force advancing on several recently captured bases following their successful occupation. They'll almost certainly attempt to reclaim --- or even destroy --- the sites. The main {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have already reached the neutral zone and are doubling back, but they won't make it in time to stop the initial assault. We've been hired to engage the enemy and delay their attack long enough for the main forces to return. Defence-in-Depth can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat! A mighty host of foes advances upon the captured fortresses, intent on ruin. The main army hastens, but shall not reach the walls ere the first clash. We are charged to hold and harry the enemy, that the returning force may smite them in full strength.

content.original: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them.  This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence.  We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited.  If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.

content.original: There is an old Kuritan theory of warfare that says that numbers matter more than skill. Our enemies here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} have decided to put that theory to the test and have lined up a swarm of BattleMechs to attack us. We need a few elite pilots to hold off the swarm as best we can. We'll send you what help we can manage. Prove the theory wrong and be on the right side of history, Commander. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!

We'd like to hire you to recon the facility and defend it until our forces can move in. We'll have a lance with you in half a day and a logistics team within 24 hours.

content.original:
A soon-to-be-operational planetary sensor array and a missile defense battery will form the backbone of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regional defense operations.  The two facilities are linked through a common targeting network, and the destruction of either asset will compromise the effectiveness of the entire system, once operational.

{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} units are expected to probe defenses before committing heavier assault forces against whichever site appears weakest.  The governor's office has declared both installations mission-critical.

content.original: There is an old Kuritan theory of warfare that says that numbers matter more than skill. Our enemies here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} have decided to put that theory to the test and have lined up a swarm of BattleMechs to attack us. We need a few elite pilots to hold off the swarm as best we can. We'll send you what help we can manage. Prove the theory wrong and be on the right side of history, Commander. Warzones can be extremely long, come prepared for extended combat!
